claim.claim-text: 1. A method for analysis of dental attachments bonded to a patient's teeth, the method comprising:
2. The method of claim 1, further comprising analyzing the attachments to determine if they have a defect.
3. The method of claim 1, wherein identifying attachments comprises using the penetrative scan and a non-penetrative scan.

4. The method of claim 1, wherein identifying attachments from the penetrative scan comprises comparing the received penetrative scan with a with a pre-scan of the teeth taken prior to the bonding of the attachments to the teeth.
5. The method of claim 1, wherein receiving the penetrative scan further comprises receiving a surface scan of the patient's teeth.
6. The method of claim 1, wherein receiving the penetrative scan comprises receiving an Optical Coherence Tomography (OCT) scan.
7. The method of claim 1, wherein the penetrative scan includes a dental aligner worn on the subject's teeth in contact with the attachments.
8. The method of claim 7, further comprising indicating, as output, contact regions between the attachments and the dental aligner.
9. The method of claim 7, further comprising indicating, as output, gaps between the aligner and the attachments.

10. The method of claim 1, wherein analyzing the attachments to confirm that they are within an acceptable tolerance of the clinical treatment plan comprises confirming the location and/or orientation of the attachments relative to the clinical treatment plan.
11. The method of claim 1, wherein analyzing the attachments to determine if they have a defect comprises determining if the attachments have a proper size and/or shape, cracks, voids, or inclusions.
12. The method of claim 11, wherein analyzing the attachments comprises performing a shape analysis.
13. The method of claim 1, wherein the indication of the status comprises an annotated image of the patient's teeth.
14. The method of claim 1, further comprising repeating the steps after adjustment has been made, until acceptable adjustments have been made.
15. A system for analysis of dental attachments bonded to a patient's teeth, the system comprising:
